content: Hessaf guye tani salon doya diza penge beyadis. Tani koyro siyiday dinke giirisa mala giiris “Haa pude keza, buroppe hanana miishata ta nena bessana” gides.
Tani heerakka Ayanan liphiphi gaada salon diza alga beyadis. He algaza bollaka issadey uttides.
He alga bolla uttidayssa medhay Iyasiphidenne Serdinoone inqu misatiza algaza yuuyi aadhdhidi Margide geetettiza inqu misatiza zuullay dees.
Hessathoka he algaza yuuyi aadhdhida nam7u tammanne oyddu algati deettes. He algata bolla qas booththa may7o may7idi ba hu7e bolla worqa aklile woththida nam7u tammanne oyddu cimati uttida.
He algafe qas wolqanthinne daada giiris kezees. He alga sinthan poo7iza laapun xompeti deettes. Heytikka Xoossa Ayana laapunata.
He alga sinthan geesh milxi gida xolqiza mastoote misatiza abbay dees. Iza giddon alga yuushon daro ayfera diza oyddu do7ati deettes.
Koyro do7azi gaammo misatees. Nam7anthozi qas boora misatees. Heedzdzanthoza ayfesoy asa ayfeso misatees. Oydanthozi qas piradhiza golle kafo misatees.

He oyddu do7ati issoy issoy usuppun qefera deettes. Qefeta yuushoninne qefeta giddon ayfey kumides. Isti qammanne gallas, “Geeshshawu! Geeshshawu! Geeshshawu! Wursa dandayiza Godo! Kasekka ha7ikka dizaysso, burokka yaanaysso guussafe shempi erettenna.”
He do7ati he alga bolla uttidayssassinne mernappe merna gakkanaas dizayssas gitateth, bonchonne galataka shiishshiza wode ubban,
nam7u tammanne oyddu cimati mernappe merna gakkanaas diza ba alga bolla uttidayssa sinthan gupannidi izas goynnettes. Ba akliletaka he alga sinthan woththidi,

content.text: shempora dizay ne shenen gidida gish
gitateththi, bonchoynne wolqayka nees bessees” gida.
